note: A first singing exercise in three 2-minute blocks, each a different job (match, step away and back, sustain), with a drone as the reference instead of an instrument and only the notes in play shown on the staff.

exercise.title: Find Do and stay on it
exercise.focus: Matching Do over a drone in C · Do-Re-Do · holding a note
exercise.why: Matching one note and holding it steady is the base every other singing skill stands on.

sections.text: A drone gives your ear a fixed note to lean on, so you can hear yourself line up with it.
Press Play on the drone. Hum along until the sound stops wobbling against it, then open to "ah" on {{1}} and watch your pitch line on the staff sit on the note.
Sing {{1}} for one slow breath, step up to {{2}} for one breath, and back to {{1}}. Do comes home to the drone; Re rubs against it. Five times, slowly.
Breathe in low for four clicks, then sing {{1}} on "ah" for eight clicks, steady in pitch and volume. Rest, then try ten clicks, then twelve. Done when the line on the staff stays flat to the end.
